html:
The Uutaalnganu, also called the Night Island people, are an Aboriginal people of the east coast of Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, around Night Island and the coast south of Lockhart River.

They are saltwater people whose life was tied to the reefs, islands and coast inside the Great Barrier Reef. Their neighbours on the map include the Kuuku Ya'u to the north and the Lamalama to the south. Many of these east coast peoples were later gathered at the Lockhart River mission, founded in 1924. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Uutaalnganu, also called the Night Island people, are an Aboriginal people of the east coast of Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, around Night Island and the coast south of Lockhart River.
